The structure of composition Y8Fe4Pt4 (reduced formula Y2FePt) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Fe and Pt center has eight Y neighbors, and each Y center has four Fe and four Pt neighbors, all with a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement and a uniform neighbor distance of 2.8134 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Y-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Fe- and Pt-centered 8-vertex polyhedra.
